Page 1 of 3 Find this and other free resources at: https://maktaba.tetea.org Find this and other free resources at: https://maktaba.tetea.org HISTORY AND PROPHETS OF THE OLD TESTAMENT (With reference to Judges, 1 & 2 Samuel, 1 & 2 Kings, Prophets Isaiah, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Hosea, Amos, Haggai, and Zechariah)

Comment on five (5) of the items (a)–(j): (a) “The Spirit of the Lord clothed Gideon, and he sounded the trumpet.” (Judges 6:34). (4 marks) (b) “And Samuel grew, and the Lord was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.” (1 Samuel 3:19). (4 marks) (c) “Your house and your kingdom shall be made sure forever before me.” (2 Samuel 7:16). (4 marks) (d) “The Lord said to Solomon, ‘Because you have asked this, and have not asked for yourself long life or riches…’.” (1 Kings 3:11). (4 marks) (e) “So Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, ‘So may the gods do to me, if I do not make your life as the life of one of them by this time tomorrow’.” (1 Kings 19:2). (4 marks) (f) “The ox knows its owner, and the donkey its master’s crib; but Israel does not know, my people do not understand.” (Isaiah 1:3). (4 marks) (g) “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you.” (Jeremiah 1:5). (4 marks) (h) “And I will give them one heart, and put a new spirit within them.” (Ezekiel 11:19). (4 marks) (i) “Let justice roll down like waters, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.” (Amos 5:24). (4 marks) (j) “My house shall be built in it, says the Lord of hosts, and the measuring line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem.” (Zechariah 1:16). (4 marks)
Narrate the call of Samuel and explain its significance to the leadership of Israel. (20 marks)
Explain five reasons why the Israelites demanded a king and show how these reasons affected their relationship with God. (20 marks)
Examine the sins of King Solomon that led to the division of the kingdom after his reign. (20 marks)
Explain the main themes of the call of Isaiah and show their relevance to Christians today. (20 marks)
Amos condemned the social injustices of his time. Explain five of them and show their relevance to Tanzania today. (20 marks)
